decisions.reason: Close to the firm's core sensing platform and already kept through 2024, so accumulated investment and public mention make escalation of commitment likely to keep it despite any shortfalls.
Its dedicated website page and central role in power applications signal strong public commitment, making withdrawal quite unlikely under escalation of commitment.
Less central than the core modules and now two years on the market, but public mention and prior investment still favor persistence for now, though the risk is higher than for A or B.
As a newer and less central module it has less accumulated investment, but its public launch and early stage allow disappointing results to be attributed to temporary causes.
Although a service rather than hardware, it is tied to the announced charging expansion, making it strategically visible and likely to be persisted with.
